explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/77: with R(k) the diagonal Ramsey number (minimal n such that every 2-colouring of K_n has a monochromatic K_k), find lim_{k→∞} R(k)^{1/k}. The statement uses the `@[question value]` pattern: R(k)^{1/k} (real power of `diagonalRamsey k`) tends to `erdos_77.answer`. This encodes both existence of the limit and its value, which is the intended content (existence of the limit is itself part of Erdős's question). Faithful; open.
